algorithm.description: HMAC algorithm used for generating the HMAC signature. Supported algorithms  INFER_FROM_HEADER, MD5, SHA_1, SHA_224, SHA_256, SHA_384, SHA_512. Default: SHA_256

auth_header_key.description: Set if you use HMAC/token-based auth methods. This is used to retrieve a key in headers

auth_method.description: The authentication mechanism you want to use

auth_secret.description: The secret you want to use for HMAC/token-based auth methods

blob_sas_url.description: The blob SAS URL of your Azure container. Required if `bucket_service` is set to `AZURE`.

bucket_service.description: Whether to store the events in Fivetran's container service or your S3 bucket. Default value: `Fivetran`.

gcs_bucket.description: The GCS bucket name. Required if `bucket_service` is set to `GCS`.

s3_bucket.description: The S3 bucket name. Required if `bucket_service` is set to `S3`.

s3_role_arn.description: The Role ARN required for authentication. Required if `bucket_service` is set to `S3`.

signature_encoding.description: This is used in HMAC auth method to decode and verify the signature. Supported encodings BASE64 and HEXA_DECIMAL. Default: BASE64

sync_format.description: The webhooks sync format.  Default value: `Unpacked`. Unpacked messages must be valid JSON.
